svg.title: Promptly Technologies
svg.desc: Stacked wordmark. Letterforms are Bangers by Vernon Adams, released under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 and converted to paths. The fill is the site halftone magenta screened with halftone red, and the shadow is ink; both are pre-multiplied against the site paper (about #eae3d1 at 90% ink) so they read as newsprint but stay opaque. The outline is unmixed ink, matching the black rules and type on the page.
